# Shark Tank Egypt Directory (دليل شارك تانك مصر)

> An open, sourced directory of every startup that pitched on Shark Tank Egypt (شارك تانك مصر): the ask, whether a deal closed, which sharks invested and on what terms. Bilingual (Arabic and English). 227 startups, 129 recorded deals, 6 seasons including the specials. Data updated 2026-10-29.

Every outcome is recorded only when a public source states it (news articles, the show's official clips and captions); 46 outcomes are still unconfirmed and are labelled as such, never guessed. Sources are listed on each startup page and in the audit log on GitHub.

## Data
- [All deals table](https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/deals/): every recorded deal with sharks and terms, plus totals per season and per shark
- [Full text digest](https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/llms-full.txt): one line per startup with ask, outcome, sharks and sources
- [startups.json](https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/data/startups.json): the complete dataset (JSON)
- [deals.csv](https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/data/deals.csv): one row per startup (CSV)
- [Source code and audit log](https://github.com/AhmadIbrahiim/SharkTankEgypt)

## Main pages (English, under /en/; Arabic is the default, at the same paths without /en/)
